verdict: Not a site regression: two stale selectors in the product specs, one DNS misconfiguration on the smoke base URL, and one slow-load flake. The product page itself rendered correctly (200, no script or console errors).

failures.test: Product extras › opening an accordion item reveals its content
failures.summary: The test clicks a heading named 'Free Worldwide Shipping', but the page renders it with the words in a different order.
failures.evidence: Waiting for getByRole('heading', { name: 'Free Worldwide Shipping' }); the snapshot has heading "Free Shipping Worldwide" [level=3] under region "Product details".
failures.next_step: Change line 33 of product-extras.spec.ts to name 'Free Shipping Worldwide'. Check with content that the reordered heading copy was intended, and confirm the /^Every order ships free/ body text still matches.

failures.test: Product info › selecting a colour updates the stock for the selected size
failures.summary: variantButton('colour-yellow') targets an id that doesn't exist; the colour is Mustard, and the next test already uses 'colour-mustard'.
failures.evidence: Waiting for locator('#colour-yellow'); the snapshot's Select colour group has radios Sage, Charcoal, Mustard, Lime, Pink and no Yellow.
failures.next_step: Change lines 21–22 of product-info.spec.ts to variantButton('colour-mustard'), then rerun to confirm the '5 In Stock' expectation.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › home page renders with site chrome
failures.summary: The smoke spec navigates to a hostname that doesn't resolve, while every other spec reached the site at localhost:3100.
failures.next_step: Find where the smoke spec gets 'novera-web.internal' (base URL, profile or env var) and point it at http://localhost:3100, or make that hostname resolve on the runner.

failures.test: Product extras › the size chart switches between inches and centimetres
failures.summary: The first attempt timed out loading the product page in beforeEach, then passed on retry; nothing points to a page defect.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded (navigating to http://localhost:3100/, waiting until "load"); the retry got status 200 with no page or console errors.
failures.next_step: Check whether the local server was cold or still starting when the run began (add a warm-up request or wait-on before tests); if it recurs, profile what delays the 'load' event.
